annotations.title: List everything waiting for your approval

description:
[read-only] The approvals inbox: everything that waits on the user's decision, in one list. `kind` "ad_budget" is an ad agent's request above the owner's ceiling (a spend cap, a spending limit, a campaign budget), with `amount`, `changes` and a one-line `summary` of before → after; it shows only with the `approvals:decide` scope, to an owner or admin, and never a request this same connection made. `kind` "manual" or "workflow" is held content (needs `approve` or `approvals:decide`, Agency plan). Paged: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is null to see every item (`limit` sets the page size, default 50; ad requests come on the first page). Read `summary` to the user before deciding anything. Held content carries `nextLapseAt` (ISO time it goes back to Drafts without a decision, null = never): mention the soonest ones first.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/approvals.)

brandId.description: Format: string; e.g. "brandId_123". Brand identifier from list_brands; use a real ID.

cursor.description: Format: string; e.g. "eyJvIjoyMH0". `nextCursor` from the previous page of the same `status`; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Format: integer; e.g. 1. Rows per page. Default 50 for pending, the org's Rejected-list size for rejected.

status.description: Format: string; e.g. "pending". Status to select or set.
